description: Turn markdown (GitHub-flavored, with ```mermaid diagrams, $math$ / $$math$$, > [!NOTE] callouts and :emoji: shortcodes) into a link that renders it as a page on jotbins.com. Returns a ready-made markdown link to show the user. Small documents live entirely in the link; larger ones are uploaded to surl.jotbins.com for a short link that expires after 30 days unused unless keep is true.

keep.description: Make a shortened link permanent instead of expiring after 30 days unused.

shorten.description: Default "auto" shortens long links. "never" keeps the document out of any upload (long link); "always" shortens even small ones.

title.description: Link text to show instead of the document's first heading.

name: render_markdown
title: Render markdown with jotbins
